items.title: Starknet introduces wallet privacy feature for DeFi activity
items.body: Starknet’s Shadow Accounts allow users to obscure connections between their main wallets and DeFi activity, though transactions remain visible onchain.

items.title: ENS seeks DAO approval to activate upgraded Ethereum naming system
items.body: New .eth registrations would pause for hours during the transition, while existing domain holders could renew their names without migrating.

items.title: Bitmine Adds $32M in Ethereum as Tom Lee Says Firm Is Nearly 'Done Stacking'
items.body: The Ethereum treasury firm now holds 6.03 million ETH, 4.9% of supply, as Lee predicts the biggest crypto bull market yet.

items.title: Bitmine sets 5% Ether supply ‘hard cap’ as accumulation target nears
items.body: Tom Lee said Bitmine will not accumulate Ether past 5% of the supply, turning the company’s target into a ceiling.

items.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade launches on Sepolia testnet
items.body: Sepolia marks one of the final major rehearsals before the final activation of Glamsterdam, aimed at bringing more efficiency and scalability to the Ethereum mainnet.

items.title: EEZ tests atomic L1-to-L2 transaction in push to unify Ethereum
items.body: An EEZ contributor shared a 0.001 ETH cross-chain test as the project develops a framework to connect Ethereum mainnet and its rollups.
